summary: Google's new smart speaker is now available for preorder. It features a quad-core processor and 360-degree sound.
details: The Google Home Speaker is now available for preorder at $100. It features a quad-core A55-based processor clocked at 2 GHz with a dedicated NPU for local AI models.
The speaker has a single 58 mm full-range driver, producing '360-degree sound' for a uniform listening experience. It will launch on June 25.

caption:
Google's new smart speaker is now available for preorder at $100. What's new?

The Google Home Speaker is now available for preorder at $100. It features a quad-core A55-based processor clocked at 2 GHz with a dedicated NPU for local AI models.

The speaker has a single 58 mm full-range driver, producing '360-degree sound' for a uniform listening experience. It will launch on June 25.

The device integrates with Google's AI model Gemini, allowing for back-and-forth conversations. It also pairs with Google TV Streamer for immersive audio output.

#Google #SmartHome #GoogleHome #Gemini #AI

Source: Tom's Hardware, Ars Technica
